verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions only "Appointment booking pages". Nothing shows inbound meetings being distributed across a team round-robin, and nothing shows weighting or priority rules. The free/busy API and ACLs are developer building blocks a team could use to build such routing, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair
